gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p4 prints General Fund, Pool Capital Project, Debt Service, Other Governmental Funds, Total. detail[] has budget schedules for General (p9, 3,910,123), Pool Capital Project (p10, 1,561,396) and Debt Service (p11, lines 58 + 21,103 + 11,401 = 32,562). Gap 626,361 has three parts. (1) Missing fund column: Other Governmental Funds receipts (p4) TIF Taxes 18,136 + Sales Tax 219,972 + Loan Repayments Principal & Interest 74,288 + Interest Income 32,561 + Grants/Donations 59,418 + Miscellaneous 221,151 = 625,526 (printed Total Receipts). (2) Missing line: the Debt Service budget schedule p11 prints Total Cash Receipts 33,396 but only lists Property Taxes 58, Special Assessments 21,103, Interest Income 11,401 (= 32,562); the statement p4 Debt Service column prints the omitted row Miscellaneous 834 (58 + 21,103 + 11,401 + 834 = 33,396). Added from p4. (3) Rounding in the report: General Fund Miscellaneous is 35,774 on p9 (total 3,910,123) but 35,775 on p4 (total 3,910,124); 1, left as printed. Check: 5,504,081 + 625,526 + 834 = 6,130,441 vs printed 6,130,442 (difference 1, the report's own rounding).
